candidates.title: Shock Ignition Laser-Plasma Interactions in Ignition-Scale Plasmas (OSTI)
candidates.notes: Peer-reviewed paper directly on shock ignition LPI at OMEGA. Search summary indicates it contains experimental coupling data: laser energy coupling to hot electrons 1–2.5%, electron temperatures 35–45 keV. Directly addresses G-10 on coupling efficiency and LPI risk at igniting spike intensity.

candidates.title: Direct-Drive Inertial Confinement Fusion: A Review (OSTI)
candidates.notes: Comprehensive review of direct-drive ICF including coupling efficiency. Deprioritized in favor of SI-specific paper; could be extracted in a future iteration.

candidates.title: Inertial Confinement Fusion with Lasers — Betti & Hurricane (OSTI)
candidates.notes: Nature Physics review by leading NIF researchers. Covers coupling efficiency across drive schemes. Could be extracted in future iteration.

gaps_attempted.gap_description: Thermodynamic cycle specification and integration design — 'traditional power plant methods' only; steam Rankine assumed
gaps_attempted.notes: Deprioritized due to budget limits. Standard steam Rankine and sCO2 cycle parameters are available from fission literature; this gap does not require a dedicated web search. Analogue sources from fission power plant design would satisfy this at low confidence.

candidates.title: Enriched lithium and advanced nuclear (NEI Magazine)
candidates.notes: Accessible HTML article with quantitative supply projections: DEMO >60 tonnes/GW enriched Li, pilot plant requires tens of tonnes, commercial requires hundreds of tonnes. Notes current enrichment cost ~$4000/kg (COLEX process, banned). Hexium AVLIS technology with $12M funding. Addresses supply chain constraints directly. Good policy/market analysis source.

candidates.title: Development of a viable route for lithium-6 supply of DEMO and future fusion power plants (ScienceDirect)
candidates.notes: Fusion Engineering and Design journal article. Likely behind Elsevier paywall. Could be most quantitative source but inaccessible.

candidates.title: Fuels for Fusion — DOE FES presentation (Pearson 2022)
candidates.notes: DOE presentation on resource availability including Li-6. Not extracted due to budget constraints; could be valuable in future iteration.

candidates.title: Potential Lithium Requirements for Fusion Power Plants (OSTI)
candidates.notes: Classic OSTI report on lithium requirements. Older but may provide useful baseline. Not extracted due to budget constraints.

gaps_attempted.notes: NEI Magazine article extracted — provides market context and demand projections but lacks detailed cost-per-kg data. The ScienceDirect paper (Sorbom et al. or equivalent) is the most quantitative source but is paywalled. Future iteration should attempt OSTI report 6574527 and DOE FES Pearson 2022 PDF.

candidates.title: Diode-pumped solid-state laser (DPSSL) drivers for IFE — ARPA-E Fusion Workshop 2023 (Zuegel)
candidates.notes: ARPA-E workshop presentation by J. Zuegel (LLE/Rochester) on DPSSL drivers. Search summary indicates diode cost targets are discussed ($0.05–0.07/W long-term target, currently 10–30× higher). Manufacturing scale requirement noted: ~100M chips per power plant vs. 18M bars/year current capacity. Directly addresses G-15.

G-12 (thermodynamic cycle) skipped as low-priority derivable from fission analogues. G-13 (Li-6 enrichment) partially addressed — best quantitative source (ScienceDirect) is paywalled. G-10 and G-15 closed with relevant peer-reviewed/government sources.
